query:
// Returning list of maps to satisfy MCP ingestion expectations.
MATCH (u:User {id: 'perf_user_001'})-[:COLLABORATES_WITH]->(coworker:User)
OPTIONAL MATCH (coworker)-[:WORKS_ON]->(proj:Project)
WITH coworker, collect(DISTINCT proj.id) AS projects
RETURN {coworker_id: coworker.id, team: coworker.team_id, projects: projects}
ORDER BY coworker.id
LIMIT 25
